Caveat: no RNA sampled during the 124-day recovery, so the molecular persistence trajectory is unknown.

And it is the only study that tracked the same induced state to a long timepoint and showed the protective component DECAYED (heat tolerance benefit gone by 6 WPF) while a different component (growth) persisted and the damage from over-priming also persisted. Different traits therefore have different decay constants.
